title: GL1TCH Token Safety & Yield X-Ray Input

action.title: Action
action.description: Select the GL1TCH operation to run.

mint.title: Token Mint / Contract Address (or Deployer Wallet)
mint.description: Solana token mint, EVM contract address, or deployer wallet address (for action=deployer).

mints.title: Batch Token Addresses (up to 10)
mints.description: Used when action=batch: list of up to 10 Solana or EVM token addresses.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Optional chain filter (solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, tron, robinhood).

yieldKind.title: Yield Pool Kind (when action=yield)
yieldKind.description: Optional pool kind filter: lending, liquid-staking, vault, dex-lp.

stableOnly.title: Stablecoin Pools Only (when action=yield)
stableOnly.description: Filter Yield X-Ray to stablecoin pools only.

apiKey.title: Optional $GL1TCH Holder API Key
apiKey.description: Optional gk_... or gl1tch_zkap_... key for priority holder access.
